item.title: Heber City Council raises bypass questions, concerns ahead of comment forum
item.description: UDOT previously estimated that the project would cost $590.4 million if the bypass kept traffic on U.S. 40 between Potters Lane and 900 North, or $583.9 million if it cut through the North Fields instead. When UDOT published the draft environmental impact statement on Jan. 7, those numbers had ballooned to $711.9 million and $760.5 million, respectively. item.title: Wave Printing stops the presses
item.description: The sister company to The Wasatch Wave had been in business since March 1889, the same year Heber City was incorporated as a town. Since the last issue of The Wasatch Wave was published in July, and Wave Printing has now closed its doors, Heber City has lost the final remnant of its oldest continuously operating business.
